entry.title: Symbolic & SMT-Guided Equivalence Checking for EVM Bytecode and ZK-Circuit Compilers
entry.summary:
Under-constrained arithmetic gates in zkSNARK circuits and storage-aliasing bugs in Solidity/Yul compilers account for the majority of critical protocol exploits. We present an SMT-backed relational verifier that proves bit-exact equivalence between optimized EVM bytecode and Plonkish constraint systems in polynomial time for loop-bounded contracts.

Source: arXiv Cryptography (cs.CR) · Tags: #smart-contracts #formal-proofs #zkp
